name: 085.1 — where a shape is written down
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 085.1: every claim the new shapes page makes, read back off the running client — the 64-bit ids that cross as decimal strings and the grid round trip they exist for, the store table the bridge owns and you write into, the 0..1 fractions, and the {x, y} and {cur, max} shapes.
